about: Baird Medical Investment Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in research, development, manufacturing, and sales of microwave ablation and other medical devices in the People's Republic of China. The company offers microwave ablation apparatus and needles; and long and fine microwave ablation needles for the treatment of benign and malignant tumors, including thyroid nodules, liver cancer, lung cancer, and breast lumps, and uterine fibroids, as well as soft tissue ablation. It sells its products through third-party distributors. It has a strategic cooperation agreement with Tianjin Yuanshan Medical Technology Co., Ltd. to focus on global development and commercialization of next-generation IRE technologies. Baird Medical Investment Holdings Limited was founded in 2012 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
